name: Finding Neverland
look: Three stacked film stills. Top: a teary-eyed young boy with brown hair looks up and talks to a man. Middle: Johnny Depp, in a dark coat and tie, looks down at the boy with a sad, thoughtful face. Bottom: the two sit on a green park bench as Depp hugs the boy.
use: The boy says something hopeful or naive in the top panel. The man's pitying look and the comforting hug that follows imply the hard truth: it isn't going to happen.
slots: the boy's hopeful statement or question (top panel)
the man's pitying reply, often just '...' (middle panel)
examples: Dad, when I grow up I'll have time for all my hobbies, right?
The delivery window is 9 to 5, so it'll probably come early
describe: johnny depp hugging a little boy on a park bench
kid asks something hopeful and the man comforts him
sad man looks at teary boy then hugs him
three panels of a boy talking and a man consoling him
man in black coat holding a crying child on a bench
origin: From the 2004 film Finding Neverland, with Johnny Depp as J. M. Barrie comforting Freddie Highmore as young Peter on a park bench.
